sanskrit_verse: श्रेण्यादिषु तु वर्गेषु कश्चिच् चेद् द्वेष्यताम् इयात् । तेभ्य एव न साक्षी स्याद् द्वेष्टारः सर्व एव ते ॥
transliteration: śreṇyādiṣu tu vargeṣu kaścit ced dveṣyatām iyāt | tebhya eva na sākṣī syād dveṣṭāraḥ sarva eva te ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If any person among groups such as Śreṇi becomes an object of hatred, none from those very groups shall be a witness; all who harbor enmity are disqualified.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from neutrality and integrity, not affiliation.
Causation arises through conscious alignment, not emotional bias.
Capacity-based responsibility requires absence of personal interest or animosity.
Restoration logic demands removal of conflict-laden parties from decision-making roles.
Consciousness alignment necessitates disqualification of witnesses influenced by hatred.
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness belongs to group with demonstrated hostility toward accused THEN disqualify witness automatically.
IF individual exhibits expressed animosity toward party in case THEN exclude from testimonial capacity.
IF group identity overlaps with declared enmity THEN no member shall serve as judicial witness.
IF testimony source has conflict potential THEN discard evidence prior to deliberation phase.
IF adjudication process includes biased observer THEN realign process with neutral evaluators only.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a litigant is perceived as hostile by a collective body or faction, members of that same faction must be excluded from bearing witness. This ensures judgments originate solely from unconflicted consciousness, preserving Dharma's impartiality at the highest level of legal execution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that perception clouded by dveṣa (hatred) cannot yield valid knowledge. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how biased witnessing distorts truth progressively. Therefore, responsibility lies in recognizing and removing such distortions without assigning fault. The non-punitive reality rule confirms exclusion serves restoration, not retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Identify and document all declared hostilities before initiating testimony phase.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require witnesses to affirm absence of personal stake or ill will.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Replace conflicted individuals with those exhibiting pure consciousness.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Reconstruct evidentiary chain exclusively through neutral observers.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. Hatred invalidates testimony. Neutrality restores justice. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma is executed.
